home.name: Daniil Tarasov
home.news: Tarasov has unexpectedly been getting more playing time in recent weeks, emerging as one of the NHL's most consistent goalies this season. The 27-year-old is coming off a 31-save performance for his second shutout of the season in a 2-0 win over the Tampa Bay Lightning. In nine games (3-3-2), Tarasov has a stellar 1.84 GAA and a .931 SV%.

away.name: Jacob Fowler
away.news: Jakub Dobes had a breakout 2025-26 season, leading the Canadiens to an impressive playoff run, but his sluggish start to 2026-27 opened the door for Jacob Fowler, who hasn't backed down from the challenge. That said, the 21-year-old Fowler is coming off a rare regulation loss, just his second of the season (9-2-2), allowing three goals on 26 shots (.885 SV%) in a 3-1 loss to the New York Rangers. The Canadiens enter Wednesday's game as +149 road underdogs against a red-hot New Jersey Devils team that has scored four or more goals in seven of their last eight games (7-1-0).

home.name: Connor Hellebuyck
home.news: Hellebuyck has been excellent since joining the Devils, yet to lose a game (7-0-0), and will return to the crease on Wednesday. The 33-year-old American goalie is coming off his busiest outing of the season, saving 42 of 46 shots (.913 SV%) in a 7-4 win over the Washington Capitals. In his last three games (3-0-0), Hellebuyck has a 2.01 GAA and .938 SV%. The Devils enter Wednesday's game as -162 home favourites against a Montreal Canadiens team that has been outscored 7-2 in their past two games (0-2-0).

away.name: Mackenzie Blackwood
away.news: Blackwood has had some ups and downs early in the 2026-27 season, but remains Colorado's go-to option, as Scott Wedgewood has been unable to find his footing. Inconsistencies aside, Blackwood has won 11 of 15 starts (3-1-1) and is coming off a solid 25-save performance (.962 SV%), defeating the Montreal Canadiens 4-1. In his last three games (3-0-0), Blackwood has a 1.34 GAA and a .952 SV%. The Avalanche enter Wednesday's game as -101 road underdogs against a struggling Utah Mammoth team that has lost six straight games (0-3-3).
